source.readMethod: git ls-tree inventory and git show raw blobs; source checkout and index never changed

vendoring.rule: Copy every regular file under contracts/ byte for byte, preserving relative paths. No files outside contracts/ are imported.
vendoring.evidence: The previous pin contained all 42 contracts/ files. The final tree has 21 mechanism artifacts plus 176 manifest-listed cases and the manifest. The manifest lists cases only, so copying only its files would omit profile and verdict dependencies. Comparator executables are outside contracts/ and remain metadata only.

vectorConsistency.method: Compared all previous pin paths and raw digests to the final git blobs. Only the manifest changes; no vector uses manifest bytes as an operation input or expected output. All 486 vectors transitively verify its provenance. The expectation file and seal are unchanged. Original canonical cases retain identical full bytes. For 45 matching public case IDs, compare input JSON, expected status and output JSON with explicit role mapping input -> matrixInput, output -> outcome. Other vectors use literal or unchanged fixture artifacts; no new cases are silently adopted into the sealed set.

reasons.original-canonical-bytes-unchanged: Original canonical case and every referenced artifact retain identical bytes, so the input and verdict do not change.
reasons.new-public-matrix-agrees: New case publication adds authority but changes no input or expected value; only artifact role labels differ.
reasons.literal-or-unchanged-artifact: Literal/local frozen inputs and every previously available corpus artifact are unchanged; added files do not replace dependencies.

resealPolicy: Only corpus metadata, pin references, freeze hashes, verification code and receipt provenance are resealed. No expectation or expectation seal is rewritten. Existing campaign results in refreshed historical receipts are historical, not newly claimed runtime proof.
